Looking for a stable, well-paid job in production where you can work with your hands and make a real impact? Join MGG in Tegelen as a Production Worker (Grinder) and become an essential part of the manufacturing process. In this role, you will grind, finish, and inspect aluminum products to ensure they meet the highest quality standards. This is a physically active position in a 3-shift system, including night shifts, making it ideal for people who enjoy practical, hands-on work and are not afraid of a challenge. Wie zoeken we? The basic hourly wage is €16.06. You will receive a 120% bonus for all hours worked, whether you work early, late, or night shifts. €16.06 x 120% = €19.27. On top of that, you will also receive €0.91 in ADV per hour worked: €19.27 + €0.91 = €20.18 gross per hour. Functieomschrijving This job is perfect for you if you like hands-on work that keeps you active during your shift. Your workday will consist of: Grinding and finishing aluminum products Working with tools and machines Loading products into machines and robots Checking product quality It's a plus if you have worked in metal of construction or other production areas, but technical experience is not required. You will work in a 3-shift system that consists of the following working hours: 5:45 AM – 1:45 PM, 1:45 PM – 9:45 PM, 9:45 PM – 5:45 AM. Apply now and become part of the team at MGG in Tegelen!
